findings.title: SBOM is a 90-day CI artifact, not bound to the release attestation
findings.impact: After 90 days there is no retrievable, signed inventory for a released artifact, weakening vulnerability response.
findings.recommendation: Publish the SBOM (and its hash) to a durable release location and reference it from the launch attestation identity.

report: SBOM and licence posture: CycloneDX SBOM generated per CI run with the lockfile-pinned tool and uploaded as a commit-bound 90-day artifact; an offline production licence allow-list is merge-gating (license-assurance.mjs). Residual: the SBOM lives only as a CI artifact and is not bound to the signed release identity/images.
